options.name: label
options.description: Chart title: visible text and the accessible name of the plot (aria-labelledby). Must not be blank.

options.name: hideLabel
options.description: Visually hide the title; it stays the accessible name.

options.name: description
options.description: Visible description below the title, also referenced by aria-describedby (text only).

options.name: summary
options.description: Replaces the generated accessible summary (series and category counts, per-series lowest and highest median, hidden series).

options.name: valueFormat
options.description: Number format for statistics in box names, the tooltip, the data table, the summary, and axis ticks (ticks use fixed fraction digits).

options.name: formatValue
options.description: Custom value text; overrides valueFormat everywhere except axis ticks.

options.name: hiddenSeries
options.description: Ids of series hidden initially; update() replaces the hidden set.

options.name: categories
options.description: Category labels, one per box group (text only).

options.name: series
options.description: Series: { id, label, data: BoxPlotDatum[], color?: 1-8 }, one datum per category. A datum is precomputed statistics { min, q1, median, q3, max, outliers? } (finite, min <= q1 <= median <= q3 <= max; min and max are the whisker ends), raw values number[] (non-finite values ignored), or null (no box).

options.name: categoryAxis
options.description: Category axis title; also the first data table column header (default "Category").

options.name: valueAxis
options.type: BoxPlotValueAxis ({ label?: string; min?: number; max?: number; tickCount?: number; includeZero?: boolean })
options.description: Value axis title, fixed domain (max > min; marks are clamped to it), and approximate tick count (2-20). includeZero is validated but has no effect on a box plot; the automatic domain spans every whisker and outlier.

options.name: annotations
options.description: Reference lines ({ type: 'line', axis: 'x' | 'y', value, label?, tone? }) and bands ({ type: 'band', axis, from, to, label?, tone? }); tone: 'neutral' | 'info' | 'success' | 'warning' | 'danger'. x values are category labels or indexes; y values are numbers. Drawn under the marks (aria-hidden); listed in the accessible summary.

options.name: theme
options.description: Look and feel: { palette?: string[] (1-8 CSS colors for slots 1-8); fontFamily?; fontSize? (8-32 px); textColor?; gridLines?: boolean; gridColor?; gridDash? ("4 2" or "none"); axisColor?; lineWidth? (0.5-12 px); markerSize? (1-20 px); cornerRadius?, barRadius?, cellRadius?, sliceRadius?, boxRadius? (0-50 px); swatchRadius? (0-8 px); tooltipRadius?, controlRadius? (0-50 px); lineJoin?: 'round' | 'miter' | 'bevel'; areaOpacity? (0-1); gradient?: boolean; valueLabelColor?; tooltip?: { background?, color?, borderColor? }; legendPosition?: 'top' | 'bottom' | 'start' | 'end'; animation?: boolean | { duration?: number (0-5000 ms) } }. Applied as --aui-chart-* custom properties and classes on the host through the CSSOM (CSP-safe); colors are validated with CSS.supports('color'). Animation is opt-in and never runs with prefers-reduced-motion: reduce or [data-aui-animation='none'].

options.name: renderTooltip
options.description: Custom tooltip content as DOM nodes (never HTML strings). context: { title, rows: { label, value, seriesId }[], column, row, source: "pointer" | "focus" | "sync" }. Return null for the default tooltip. The tooltip stays aria-hidden; the focused mark keeps its accessible label.

options.name: syncGroup
options.description: Synchronized crosshair: charts with the same group show the crosshair, highlight, and tooltip at the same column (category or x index) when one of them is hovered or focused. Focus never moves between charts. Use charts that share their categories or x values.

options.name: legend
options.description: auto: legend (toggle buttons) when there is more than one series.

options.name: dataTable
options.description: Data table fallback (one row per category and series: Minimum, Lower quartile, Median, Upper quartile, Maximum, Outliers): behind a Show data table button (built on first open), always visible, visually hidden (screen readers only), or none.

options.name: tooltip
options.description: Tooltip on pointer hover and keyboard focus (maximum, quartiles, median, minimum, outlier count).

options.name: patterns
options.description: Texture fills on the boxes (and legend keys) of the second and later series so series never differ by color alone (always on in forced colors).

options.name: height
options.description: Plot height in CSS px (integer 120-2000); the width follows the container.

options.name: whiskers
options.description: Whiskers computed from raw values: tukey (whiskers end at the most extreme values within 1.5 IQR of the quartiles; values beyond are outliers) or minmax (whiskers at the minimum and maximum, no outliers). Precomputed statistics are drawn as given.

options.name: locale
options.description: Number, list, and message locale.

options.name: direction
options.description: rtl mirrors the category axis and series order, moves the value axis to the right, and swaps ArrowLeft/ArrowRight.

properties.name: element
properties.description: The plot (svg role="group"), named by the title and described by the summary.

properties.name: hiddenSeries
properties.description: Ids of hidden series, in data order.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Merge, validate, and re-render. Invalid options throw and keep the previous state. Keyboard focus stays on the same box (series id and category).

methods.name: setSeriesVisible
methods.description: Show or hide a series programmatically; emits no event.

methods.name: destroy
methods.description: Remove rendering, host classes, listeners, the resize observer, and the configuration subscription.

methods.name: boxStats
methods.signature: boxStats(values: readonly number[], whiskers?: BoxPlotWhiskers): BoxPlotStats | null
methods.description: Module function (not an instance method), exported from @absoluteui/components/box-plot: five-number summary and outliers of raw values with the same rules the chart uses (non-finite values ignored; whiskers default 'tukey'). Returns null when no finite value remains. Use it to precompute statistics for large samples.

methods.name: quantile
methods.signature: quantile(sorted: readonly number[], p: number): number
methods.description: Module function (not an instance method): quantile p (0-1) of ascending values with linear interpolation (Hyndman-Fan type 7, as in spreadsheets). NaN for an empty array. The input must already be sorted.

events.name: aui-series-toggle
events.detail: { id: string; visible: boolean; hidden: string[] }
events.description: The user toggled a legend entry (pointer or keyboard). Not emitted for update() or setSeriesVisible().

events.name: aui-point-click
events.detail: BoxPlotPointClickDetail = ChartPointClickDetail: { seriesId: string | null; column: number; row: number; label: string; series: string; value: string; source: 'pointer' | 'keyboard' }
events.description: A data mark was activated: pointer click or tap, or Enter / Space on the focused mark. label is the category, x value, or item; value is the formatted value text. Keyboard navigation is unchanged.

cssClasses.name: aui-box-plot
cssClasses.description: Host modifier for this chart type.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__header / __title / __title--hidden / __description / __toolbar
cssClasses.description: Title and description; the toolbar stays hidden.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__swatch
cssClasses.description: aria-hidden legend and tooltip key (fill and texture).

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__body / __svg / __layer
cssClasses.description: Plot container (height from --aui-chart-height), SVG, and drawing layer.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__series--c1 ... --c8
cssClasses.description: Palette slot classes; set --aui-chart-color from color-chart-<n>.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__tooltip / __tooltip-title / __tooltip-rows / __tooltip-row / __tooltip-label / __tooltip-value
cssClasses.description: Tooltip (aria-hidden; the focused box carries the same text).

cssClasses.name: aui-chart__empty
cssClasses.description: Empty state text (No data, All series are hidden).

cssClasses.name: aui-box-plot__boxes / __series
cssClasses.description: All boxes, and one group per box (series color slot).

cssClasses.name: aui-box-plot__box
cssClasses.description: The focusable box (lower to upper quartile).

cssClasses.name: aui-box-plot__whiskers / __whisker / __outlier
cssClasses.description: Decorative (aria-hidden) whiskers with caps and outlier dots.

cssClasses.name: aui-chart--no-grid / --gradient / --animate / --entering
cssClasses.description: theme.gridLines: false, theme.gradient, theme.animation (entering: the render that animates).
